### Bible Pathways 02/24/2002
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-02-or-24-or-2002-1127468.html
Passage: Numbers 27:22-23
Points:
- Despite facing deep disappointment at not entering Canaan, Moses maintained a humble spirit.
- Moses willingly surrendered his authority and faithfully carried out God's command to commission Joshua.
- Joshua was chosen for leadership because the Spirit of God dwelt within him.
- Believers are challenged to overcome complaints during stressful trials by submitting fully to God.
- Daily circumstances test whether a Christian will represent self or represent Christ.
